newsitem.title: USA: Lowrance Electronics sees fiscal 1997 loss.
newsitem.headline: Lowrance Electronics sees fiscal 1997 loss.

text.p: Lowrance Electronics Inc said on Friday that it will not be profitable in fiscal 1997.

In March, Lowrance had predicted that the company would earn a profit in 1997. But operating inefficiencies at the Tulsa facility and higher labor costs have cut into operating margins, Lowrance said.
In a press release, company president Darrell Lowrance said July fourth quarter revenues should exceed last year's fourth quarter revenues of $27.2 million.
Lowrance said incremental expenses have been reduced during the fourth quarter, and the company will benefit from those savings in fiscal 1998, which is expected to be profitable, Lowrance said.
Analysts' earnings projections for fiscal 1997 were not available. The company reported a profit of $0.52 on net income of $1.7 million for fiscal 1996.
Through the first nine months of fiscal 1997, the company reported a loss of $2.4 million or $0.72 per share on $73.8 million in revenues.
